descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: delete scope per chart.

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S27 A delete is scoped to one chart: the same drug, task and point on another patient and in Nursing Home stay, and new dictation on other charts still creates the row

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A deleted medication row, task or Important Point does not reappear on the next day's processing (or any later processing) unless the physician dictates it again. (UAT TC-24; TFA-94699 AC 5; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician. The fixture Hospital patient, control 'QA Hosp Keep <tag>' and the Nursing Home resident each carry 'Metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO BID', the task 'Call daughter re: goals of care' and the point 'Check heel ulcer dressing'. …

When On the fixture patient delete the row, the task and the point, then type a pre-round text and press Save Note. Check the control patient and the resident. Then dictate metoprolol on the two new charts (Save Note; Save & Extract).

Then The control patient and the resident still have all three items. Both new charts get a metoprolol row: the 'never comes back' rule is kept per chart, not per account, drug name or text.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94699 AC 5 and the 'data from another patient or context' risk (test-design §2). oracle.mjs: every control checkpoint must contain the item; the new charts must show their own metoprolol row. Row presence is read in the Medications editor ('Remove <name>' per row), where a course or medication-event panel cannot stand in for a row (oracleRules 2). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
